rv.q: There are also jokes that you will only fully appreciate if you understand ancient antagonisms between Yorkshire’s West and North Ridings and why “Cadbury’s” (in a place built around Rowntree’s) is a punchline.
This production is an apt, novel and engaging way to honour the history of the very stage on which it’s being performed, and the community that surrounds it.
York Theatre Royal are masters of producing these large community show and they don’t disappoint here.

cn.t: This large-scale community production about social reformer Seebohm Rowntree earns praise as a moving, dynamic celebration that finds universal resonance in a local York story, despite its necessarily parochial scope.
